source_definitions.name: OpenAI News
source_definitions.conclusion_reason: The official RSS is usable for discovery, but the site terms prohibit automatic or programmatic extraction.
source_definitions.discovery_method: Official RSS; retain canonical article links.
source_definitions.extraction_adapter: RSS or Atom metadata adapter; article-body fetching disabled.
source_definitions.cursor: Latest feed publication or update timestamp plus canonical URL.
source_definitions.health_policy: Require valid RSS, stable canonical links and dates, and successful responses without challenge signals.
source_definitions.robots_findings: Allows the News paths, but robots permission does not override the site terms.
source_definitions.terms_findings: Associated-site terms prohibit automatic or programmatic extraction of data or output.
source_definitions.storage_policy: Store feed metadata and a source-supplied feed description only; do not fetch or store article bodies.
source_definitions.public_excerpt_policy: Publish an original AI-marked paraphrase and canonical link; no source excerpt by default.
pause_conditions: canonical URL or date parsing fails

source_definitions.name: Anthropic News
source_definitions.conclusion_reason: No official feed or reliable robots response was verified, while the consumer terms prohibit automated access unless permitted.
source_definitions.discovery_method: Static or paginated index; no official feed verified.
source_definitions.extraction_adapter: Disabled pending permission verification; no automated adapter selected.
source_definitions.cursor: None while disabled; a future adapter must define a stable publication timestamp and canonical URL cursor.
source_definitions.health_policy: Remain inactive until robots and explicit automated-access permission are captured and reviewed.
source_definitions.robots_findings: The official robots URL could not be reliably retrieved during this review.
source_definitions.terms_findings: Prohibits crawling, scraping, harvesting, or automated non-human access except where explicitly permitted.
source_definitions.storage_policy: Keep disabled; manual review may retain only Publisher and entry-point metadata.
source_definitions.public_excerpt_policy: No automated article records, body storage, or public excerpts.
pause_conditions: robots or explicit automated-access permission remains unresolved

source_definitions.name: Google AI
source_definitions.conclusion_reason: The official RSS can be filtered to the AI section and the applicable robots rules allow that path.
source_definitions.extraction_adapter: RSS or Atom metadata adapter with an AI-section filter.
source_definitions.cursor: Latest feed publication or update timestamp plus canonical URL.
source_definitions.health_policy: Require valid RSS, in-scope AI category metadata, stable canonical links, and no access challenge.
source_definitions.robots_findings: Disallows search-query paths, not the AI section or official feed.
source_definitions.terms_findings: Automated access must comply with machine-readable instructions; Google and third-party IP rights remain reserved.
source_definitions.storage_policy: Store feed or index metadata and source-supplied summaries; never mirror the body or media.
source_definitions.public_excerpt_policy: Publish an original AI-marked paraphrase or short attributed excerpt plus canonical link.
pause_conditions: AI or feed path is disallowed
feed schema or canonical path drifts

source_definitions.name: Google DeepMind
source_definitions.conclusion_reason: An official RSS exists, but the effective robots policy could not be captured reliably.
source_definitions.discovery_method: Official RSS plus the paginated DeepMind News index.
source_definitions.extraction_adapter: Disabled pending robots verification; intended RSS or Atom metadata adapter.
source_definitions.cursor: None while disabled; after approval use feed publication or update timestamp plus canonical URL.
source_definitions.health_policy: Remain inactive until effective robots rules are captured; then require valid RSS and stable canonical metadata.
source_definitions.robots_findings: The official robots URL could not be reliably retrieved during this review.
source_definitions.terms_findings: Requires compliance with machine-readable instructions and preserves content IP.
source_definitions.storage_policy: Store nothing until robots is captured and reviewed; if cleared, retain feed metadata and source-supplied summaries only.
source_definitions.public_excerpt_policy: After clearance, publish an original paraphrase or short attributed excerpt plus link; no full body or media.
pause_conditions: robots remains unavailable or disallows the path

source_definitions.name: Meta AI
source_definitions.conclusion_reason: Official policy requires express written permission for automated data collection.
source_definitions.discovery_method: Static index or sitemap only; no official feed verified.
source_definitions.extraction_adapter: Disabled; no automated adapter permitted without express written permission.
source_definitions.health_policy: Remain blocked until written permission covering the exact paths and use is recorded.
source_definitions.robots_findings: States that automated data collection is prohibited without express written permission and blocks crawler and path classes.
source_definitions.terms_findings: Requires separate express written permission and compliance with robots and header opt-outs.
source_definitions.storage_policy: Do not perform automated discovery or retain discovered article content; keep only the disabled definition and policy evidence.
pause_conditions: written permission does not cover the exact paths and use

source_definitions.name: Microsoft Research
source_definitions.conclusion_reason: The official feed is available, but Microsoft reserves content rights and restricts copying and distribution.
source_definitions.discovery_method: Official RSS for the Microsoft Research Blog.
source_definitions.extraction_adapter: RSS or Atom metadata adapter; article-body fetching disabled.
source_definitions.cursor: Latest feed publication or update timestamp plus canonical URL.
source_definitions.health_policy: Require valid RSS, stable canonical links and dates, and successful responses without challenge signals.
source_definitions.robots_findings: Contains many specific exclusions but none for the Research Blog or feed paths.
source_definitions.terms_findings: Reserves content rights and generally restricts copying, distribution, reproduction, and publication.
source_definitions.storage_policy: Store RSS metadata and source-supplied description only; do not fetch or store the article body.
source_definitions.public_excerpt_policy: Publish an original AI-marked paraphrase and canonical link; no source excerpt by default.
pause_conditions: Research or feed path is disallowed

source_definitions.name: NVIDIA Generative AI
source_definitions.conclusion_reason: NVIDIA site terms prohibit robots, spiders, scrapers, crawlers, and data-extraction tools without permission.
source_definitions.discovery_method: Official Atom feed for the Generative AI tag.
source_definitions.extraction_adapter: Disabled; no automated adapter permitted without written permission or an explicit feed-license exception.
source_definitions.health_policy: Remain blocked until permission is recorded and re-review confirms compatible machine-readable instructions.
source_definitions.robots_findings: Allows the tag and feed paths, but the stricter site terms control activation.
source_definitions.terms_findings: Governing site terms prohibit automated content access, acquisition, copying, or monitoring without permission.
source_definitions.storage_policy: Do not automate discovery or store feed or article records; retain only policy evidence.
pause_conditions: written permission or explicit feed-license exception is absent

source_definitions.name: Hugging Face Blog
source_definitions.conclusion_reason: The official feed and index are allowed, with metadata-tier use and per-author license caution.
source_definitions.discovery_method: Official RSS plus the Blog index.
source_definitions.extraction_adapter: RSS or Atom metadata adapter with author and organization provenance.
source_definitions.cursor: Latest feed publication or update timestamp plus canonical URL.
source_definitions.health_policy: Require valid RSS, explicit author provenance, stable canonical links, and successful responses after bounded backoff.
source_definitions.terms_findings: Preserves website and materials rights; individual artifacts retain their own licenses and the Blog includes community authors.
source_definitions.storage_policy: Store feed or index metadata and source-supplied description; retain author or organization identity; do not mirror body or media.
source_definitions.public_excerpt_policy: Publish an original AI-marked paraphrase or short attributed excerpt and link without implying community content is Hugging Face-authored or openly licensed.

source_definitions.name: DeepSeek Changelog
source_definitions.conclusion_reason: DeepSeek terms prohibit robots and spiders, so only human-maintained metadata is allowed.
source_definitions.discovery_method: Human-reviewed static changelog index; no official RSS verified.
source_definitions.extraction_adapter: Manual metadata review only; automated adapter disabled by terms.
source_definitions.cursor: Last manually reviewed changelog date and canonical URL.
source_definitions.health_policy: Require a human policy check before each metadata update and stop on host migration or access challenge.
source_definitions.robots_findings: Returned application HTML rather than a valid robots file during review.
source_definitions.terms_findings: Prohibits robots, spiders, or similar programs from crawling or copying Service content.
source_definitions.storage_policy: No automated discovery; a human-maintained record may store title, date, and canonical URL only.
source_definitions.public_excerpt_policy: No body storage or public excerpt; publish only an original paraphrase and link.

source_definitions.name: Qwen Blog
source_definitions.conclusion_reason: The new host has no valid captured robots file and no clear automated-access or reuse authorization was verified.
source_definitions.discovery_method: Dynamic Blog index after migration from the former official GitHub Pages site.
source_definitions.extraction_adapter: Disabled pending robots and permission verification; no automated adapter selected.
source_definitions.cursor: None while disabled; a future adapter must define a stable publication timestamp and canonical URL cursor.
source_definitions.health_policy: Remain inactive until valid robots and content permissions are captured and the dynamic entry point is stable.
source_definitions.robots_findings: Returned application HTML rather than a valid robots file; the old host's rules do not govern the new host.
source_definitions.terms_findings: No clear crawler or content-reuse authorization was verified.
source_definitions.storage_policy: Keep disabled and retain only the definition entry point and review evidence.
source_definitions.public_excerpt_policy: No automated article metadata, body, or public excerpts until robots and content permission are confirmed.

source_definitions.name: GitHub AI and ML
source_definitions.conclusion_reason: The official category RSS is allowed for metadata-tier discovery.
source_definitions.discovery_method: Official RSS for the AI and ML category.
source_definitions.extraction_adapter: RSS or Atom metadata adapter scoped to the AI and ML category.
source_definitions.cursor: Latest feed publication or update timestamp plus canonical URL.
source_definitions.health_policy: Require valid category RSS, stable canonical links and dates, and successful responses without rate-limit signals.
source_definitions.robots_findings: Has an empty wildcard Disallow and lists sitemaps.
source_definitions.terms_findings: Reserves site and content rights; no blanket article-body redistribution grant was found.
source_definitions.storage_policy: Store feed metadata and source-supplied brief description, not the fetched article body.
source_definitions.public_excerpt_policy: Publish a short attributed feed excerpt or original AI-marked paraphrase plus canonical link; never mirror body or images.
pause_conditions: blog or feed path is disallowed

source_definitions.name: GitHub Changelog
source_definitions.conclusion_reason: The official Changelog RSS is allowed for bounded metadata discovery.
source_definitions.extraction_adapter: RSS or Atom metadata adapter scoped to Changelog entries.
source_definitions.cursor: Latest feed publication or update timestamp plus canonical URL.
source_definitions.health_policy: Require valid Changelog RSS, stable canonical links and dates, and successful responses without rate-limit signals.
source_definitions.robots_findings: Allows crawling for the wildcard user agent.
source_definitions.terms_findings: Preserves content and intellectual-property rights, bounding approval to feed discovery and metadata.
source_definitions.storage_policy: Store title, date, change type or labels, canonical URL, and source-supplied brief description; not article bodies.
source_definitions.public_excerpt_policy: Publish a short attributed feed excerpt or original AI-marked paraphrase plus canonical link.

source_definitions.name: arXiv AI queries
source_definitions.conclusion_reason: The dedicated API permits descriptive metadata, including abstracts, under CC0 when its access limits and attribution requirements are followed.
source_definitions.discovery_method: Versioned API queries for AI-relevant categories; never scrape search pages.
source_definitions.extraction_adapter: Official arXiv legacy API metadata adapter with configured category queries.
source_definitions.cursor: Latest API updated timestamp plus arXiv identifier and version.
source_definitions.health_policy: Use one connection and at most one request every three seconds; require valid Atom metadata and attribution.
source_definitions.robots_findings: Forbids indiscriminate automated downloads, sets a website crawl delay, and disallows /api to generic crawlers; use the dedicated API policy instead.
source_definitions.terms_findings: Allows descriptive metadata retrieval, storage, transformation, and sharing under CC0; legacy API use is limited to one connection and one request every three seconds; e-print redistribution requires separate permission.
source_definitions.storage_policy: Store API metadata including abstract, identifier and version, authors, categories, timestamps, and original links; do not download or serve e-prints without verifying their licenses.
source_definitions.public_excerpt_policy: Show API metadata or abstract, or an original AI-marked summary, with arXiv attribution and canonical link.
pause_conditions: one-request-per-three-seconds or single-connection rule cannot be honored
API, CC0, or attribution terms change
query volume is out of scope

source_definitions.name: Curated GitHub Releases
source_definitions.conclusion_reason: The official REST endpoint supports bounded public metadata retrieval for an explicit repository allowlist.
source_definitions.discovery_method: One configuration-backed definition with a versioned repository allowlist and per-repository release filters.
source_definitions.extraction_adapter: Official GitHub REST Releases API adapter; HTML scraping and asset downloads disabled.
source_definitions.cursor: Per-repository latest eligible release ID and published timestamp.
source_definitions.health_policy: Honor API versioning, Retry-After and rate-limit headers; verify repository identity and configured release filters.
source_definitions.robots_findings: HTML robots rules are not the acquisition authority because this definition uses the official REST API and never scrapes GitHub HTML.
source_definitions.terms_findings: API use must avoid abuse, excessive requests, rate-limit evasion, and spam; repository release notes remain their authors' Content.
source_definitions.storage_policy: Store release metadata, canonical repository identity, release ID, tag, name, timestamps, flags, and URLs; store notes only when repository-specific permission is verified; never fetch assets by default.
source_definitions.public_excerpt_policy: Publish an original AI-marked paraphrase plus canonical link; use a short excerpt only when repository-specific policy permits.
pause_conditions: repository is removed, renamed, transferred, or archived
filters fail to exclude configured drafts, prereleases, or automated builds

source_definitions.name: Machine Heart
source_definitions.conclusion_reason: The article index is not disallowed, but first-party copyright terms do not grant reuse permission.
source_definitions.discovery_method: Dynamic or semi-dynamic article index; no official feed or API verified.
source_definitions.extraction_adapter: Publisher-specific index metadata adapter only; body extraction, login, PRO, and paid paths disabled.
source_definitions.cursor: Latest visible publication timestamp plus canonical article URL.
source_definitions.health_policy: Require accessible public index metadata, stable canonical URLs, and no login, paywall, challenge, or parser drift.
source_definitions.robots_findings: Disallows /cable and lists a sitemap; the article index is not disallowed.
source_definitions.terms_findings: Self-produced reports may not be copied or distributed without written permission; no separate ordinary-article reuse authorization was found.
source_definitions.storage_policy: Store title, date, author, canonical URL, and Topic from the index only; do not enter login, PRO, or paid paths.
source_definitions.public_excerpt_policy: No body or public excerpt; publish only an original AI-marked paraphrase and canonical link.
pause_conditions: login, PRO, or paywall is encountered
permission is insufficient for requested use

source_definitions.name: Qbitai
source_definitions.conclusion_reason: The official RSS is discoverable, but first-party copyright notices prohibit unauthorized reproduction or use.
source_definitions.extraction_adapter: RSS or Atom metadata adapter with feed descriptions discarded.
source_definitions.cursor: Latest feed publication or update timestamp plus canonical URL.
source_definitions.health_policy: Require valid RSS, stable canonical links and dates, and successful responses without challenge signals.
source_definitions.robots_findings: Disallows /wp-admin/ and allows its Ajax endpoint; feed and article paths are not disallowed.
source_definitions.terms_findings: First-party article footers reserve all rights and prohibit unauthorized reproduction or use; no separate reuse grant was found.
source_definitions.storage_policy: Store title, date, author, canonical URL, and tags only; do not retain feed descriptions, article bodies, or excerpts.
source_definitions.public_excerpt_policy: Publish only an original AI-marked paraphrase and canonical link.
pause_conditions: article or feed path is disallowed
